task: T5 retail price ladder (lemon, lime and clear carbonated cans and soda waters, 325 to 345 mL), revised 20 October 2026
method: Each row is checked first: its anchor (URL, listing number or product name) must occur in its saved raw file, and the printed pack price (baht sign or THB) must appear within 900 characters after it or 200 characters before it; where a per-unit price is printed it must appear too and agree with pack price / pack count. This is a presence check on the saved extracts, not a parse. Then per can = pack price / pack count; per 330 mL = per can x 330 / can mL; per litre = per can / can litres. Set A (main) admits can rows from a retailer page, or a Priceza offer whose seller is an official store or a named seller, and excludes bundles, out-of-stock, unavailable, bottles, out-of-range sizes, unnamed sellers and non-lemon, non-lime flavours. No random numbers; no seed. A row that fails stops the run before any output is written, so a results file with all_rows_pass true means every row passed on that run.
